paper_title: Search for an axion-like particle in radiative $J/ψ$ decays
notes: BESIII search for ALP in radiative J/psi decays, a->gamma gamma, over mass range 0.165-2.84 GeV/c^2. Most stringent g_agamma limits for 0.165-1.468 GeV. Only an example point is given numerically in text: g_agamma > 3e-4 GeV^-1 excluded near m_a ~ 0.25 GeV (2.5e8 eV). Full exclusion curve is in Fig.6 but no numerical table provided; data points cannot be reliably extracted beyond the quoted text value. Branching fraction limits 8.3e-8 to 1.8e-6 reported but not coupling values per mass. | Auto-corrected masses: Hz→eV (×4.136e-15, rule=argmin|log10(median*f)-log10(anchor=1.0e-05)|)
